title: Test Double

validation.research: Original publisher-provided chapter23 of Meszaros xUnit Test Patterns verified, pp522–528 including Imposter alias. Fowler TestDouble and MocksArentStubs verify five role distinctions and verification styles; Python official documentation verifies actual APIs; Fowler ContractTest supports checking assumptions against the actual provider. Original author website returned502; publisher original chapter was successfully read instead. Test Double is the umbrella; mock/stub/spy/fake/dummy are role variants, not aliases. No existing canonical article found. Testing and Testability is the primary home because controlled test surroundings and observation are the mechanism. New collection contains only the completed article; no future stubs.

limitations: Double-based tests do not contact a real payment provider or verify a production gateway adapter. The article explicitly requires separate adapter/integration and relevant contract checks.
No persistence, retry, payment idempotency or concurrency claim. Autospec restricts API shape but does not establish monetary/result semantics.
Existing unrelated type-check and global-graphic failures remain. Full-site static export unverified due disk capacity.
